how_it_works.title: How It Works
how_it_works.subtitle: A transparent 4-step process connecting your voice directly to local representatives
how_it_works.step1_desc: Specify your Province, District, Municipality or Village to route your report to the right authorities.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Select the category, urgency, explain the issue clearly, and attach photos or supporting documents.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Receive a unique Suggestion ID (e.g. JS-2026-000001) and instant WhatsApp confirmation format.
how_it_works.step4_title: 4. Your suggestion is recorded and reviewed
how_it_works.step4_desc: Local officers review, assign priority, initiate field actions, and update you with verifiable logs.

help.title: Frequently Asked Questions & Citizen Guide
help.subtitle: Everything you need to know about submitting and tracking community issues in Nepal
help.a1: Submissions are categorized and routed to designated local ward representatives, municipal administrative offices, and community officers responsible for the specific sector (e.g., roads, water, health).
help.q2: How can I follow up after submitting?
help.a2: Every submission receives a unique Suggestion ID (like JS-2026-000001). Use the 'Track Status' page anytime to view real-time department updates, inspection notes, and estimated completion times.
help.q3: Can I share photos or documents?
help.a3: Yes! You can attach clear photos of road damages, leaking water pipelines, waste disposal spots, or official letters up to 10MB.
help.a4: Yes, your contact details are kept secure and shared solely with designated administrative officers for verification and resolution updates.
